title: Reflected third-party scorer attribute must be a Scorer subclass before instantiation
answers: scorer payload instantiates a non-scorer class from an allowed module
third-party scorer class not a Scorer subclass error
model_validate calls a constructor on an arbitrary attribute
body:
Invariant: after getattr on the imported module, the resolved object must pass inspect.isclass(...) and issubclass(..., Scorer) before it is instantiated.
Enforced at: mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py:Scorer.model_validate, which raises invalid_parameter_value ('is not a Scorer subclass') before init_kwargs are built.
What breaks if skipped: a module-level function or non-scorer class named in the payload gets called with the caller's kwargs. Tests use fake Mock modules with a non-Scorer class and a plain function to exercise this path.
Constraints: test fixtures for scorer classes used with this path must subclass Scorer, or they will be rejected.
applies: Any change to how Scorer.model_validate resolves a class from third_party_scorer_data.
says: Configuring a third-party evaluation metric fails with an invalid scorer class error.
Custom evaluation definitions can accidentally execute arbitrary functions from the target module.
Reject any external evaluator class that does not implement the standard scorer interface.
Validate that the specified evaluation attribute is a proper scorer class before initializing.
Test evaluation fixtures are getting rejected during model evaluation parameter validation.
search: When resolving third-party scorer classes in mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py:Scorer.model_validate from third_party_scorer_data, the resolved object from getattr must pass inspect.isclass and issubclass against Scorer before instantiation. If validation fails, model_validate raises invalid_parameter_value stating it is not a Scorer subclass before init_kwargs are built, preventing arbitrary functions or non-scorer classes from being called. Applies to resolving classes from third_party_scorer_data, and test fixtures used with this path must explicitly subclass Scorer to avoid rejection.
